description: Shared aliases for transcription, guarded post-processing normalization, and role evidence. Numeric champion/item/summoner IDs and ability names/IDs come from Riot Data Dragon. Abilities are scoped by championId. Optional postProcessingAliases selects cleanup aliases; an empty array preserves shorthand for that entity. Champion-qualified ability shorthand (including possessives and ult/ultimate/R) is generated centrally from champion aliases and ability slots. Ability and item shorthand is preserved in transcripts; formal ability names are not injected into speech prompts.

abilities.name: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
